email.subject: Lobby too hot + invoice question
email.body: Hi team, since Monday the lobby at Riverside Hotel has been around 28°C in the afternoons and guests are complaining. Also, invoice INV-2291 seems to charge us twice for the September maintenance visit. Can someone call me back today? — Nok, Chief Engineer

wants_callback.instructions: Does the sender of `email` ask to be phoned or called back?
